name: Meletis
description: Meletis is the largest polis on Theros, a coastal city-state of philosophers, thaumaturges and oracles on the Siren Sea, ruled by the council known as the Twelve.

summary.text: Meletis is the largest polis on Theros, a coastal city-state of philosophers, thaumaturges and oracles on the Siren Sea, ruled by the council known as the Twelve.

citations.text: "Meletis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Kynaios and Tiro, aided by Ephara's magic, overthrew the tyrant Agnomakhos and founded Meletis on the ruins of his empire, then relinquished power to a philosopher-led republic.

citations.text: "Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Ephara is its patron god and the city is where her cult is strongest.

citations.text: "Meletis", section "Locations in the polis of Meletis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ephara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After Xenagos died, Heliod had Daxos purge Meletis of the other gods' influence, which started a war of the gods and opened rifts to the Underworld.

citations.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Meletis was struck by Kiora's tsunami and was sent hordes of minotaurs by Mogis, though heroes from Meletis joined Elspeth's army to break a siege.

citations.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Twelve and Perisophia also decided the oracle Iris must be moved in secret to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents had infiltrated the city.

citations.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

bio.text: In the Phyrexian invasion most gods were compleated while Meletis held out with Ephara's aid, though Elspeth later saw the city in ruins.

citations.text: "Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ephara bestows magic on the people of Meletis, letting them overthrow the tyrant Archon Agnomakhos.
timeline.quote: Ephara once bestowed magic upon the people of Meletis

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Elspeth slays Xenagos, Heliod has Daxos remove traces of other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war, rifts open to the Underworld, and Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod.
timeline.quote: He hated Heliod most of all, and in his rage, he neglected to keep a tight grip on the souls under his purview.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kynaios and Tiro, aided by Ephara's magic, overthrow the tyrant Agnomakhos and cast out the leonin.
timeline.quote: With their new power, Kynaios and Tiro overthrew Agnomakhos, cast out the leonin, and freed Meletis from tyranny.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire and Kynaios and Tiro relinquish power to a philosopher-led republic.
timeline.quote: which ultimately led them to relinquish their power and establish a philosopher-led republic

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ephara keeps her temple standing through an earthquake and later shares designs so Meletis can be rebuilt.
timeline.quote: Ephara kept her temple standing throughout the mighty quake

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis of other gods' influence, Purphoros and the others summon champions from the Underworld, Purphoros choosing Anax.
timeline.quote: Purphoros’s champion was Anax , former king of Akros .

citation.text: "Purphoros", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ephara inspires Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow the Archon tyrant Agnomakhos and found Meletis.
timeline.quote: Ephara inspired and equipped the human heroes Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow Agnomakhos.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod makes Daxos his champion to purge the other gods from Meletis, starting a war of the gods and opening rifts to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: the gods were at war

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod transforms Daxos into his Champion and orders him to remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis.
timeline.quote: Daxos was instructed to remove all trace of the other gods from the great city of Meletis

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A god claims Ninis and curses Xandria, who is transformed into a siren trapped in the Siren Sea.
timeline.quote: She awoke on an island and transformed into a siren .

citation.text: "Xandria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sirens spot a Meletian trireme far off course in the storm and Xandria flies toward it.
timeline.quote: The ship was a trireme out of Meletis, large and majestic

citation.text: "The Consequences of Attraction". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Xandria and Ninis meet at the academy in Meletis, talk for days and spend a night together on the beach.
timeline.quote: until one night they walked onto the beaches outside the school, and they stayed together throughout the night

citation.text: "The Consequences of Attraction". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: a god appears from the water, leaving Ninis unwakeable.
timeline.quote: He will not wake.

citation.text: "The Consequences of Attraction". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the god reveals it marked Ninis as its own at birth and curses Xandria with the consequences of attraction.
timeline.quote: I marked him as mine when he was a baby in his mother's arms.

citation.text: "The Consequences of Attraction". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the god touches Xandria, transforming her into a siren and condemning her never to leave or die.
timeline.quote: You will learn the consequences of attraction.

citation.text: "The Consequences of Attraction". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes from Akros, Meletis and Setessa to break the siege; the victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god.
timeline.quote: the victory celebration after the battle became the ultimate ritual to launch Xenagos into Nyx as a god.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives on Theros and raises a huge wave to call sea beasts, damaging the shore near Meletis.
timeline.quote: she raised up an enormous wave to call to the ocean beasts.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Perisophia opens a lesson in Meletis by asking her students what identity is, using the example of a leonin cub raised by wolves.
timeline.quote: "What is identity? What makes us who we are?"

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Perisophia urges her students to dwell in the mystery rather than hastily answering.
timeline.quote: Dwell in the mystery for a bit and see what arises.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Melia cites Phelos, and Perisophia presses whether identity can be an object of knowledge.
timeline.quote: Can you know yourself? Can your identity be an object of knowledge, or is it something entirely different?

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Samia asks about the Returned and eidolons, and Perisophia explains that they lack the capacity for an identity.
timeline.quote: It would appear that the Returned and the eidolons lack the capacity for an identity.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Salis raises the story of Matatios, and Perisophia warns that Matatios only met himself and did not become aware of himself.
timeline.quote: Matatios did not become aware of himself, he only met himself.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Perisophia ends the lesson by saying that identity lives in the moment and that each person is the architect of it.
timeline.quote: Identity is not in the past, nor does it dwell in the future. It lives in the moment.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Mogis sends hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa.
timeline.quote: Mogis , the god of slaughter sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros , Meletis , and Setessa .

citation.text: "Born of the Gods", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Soldiers in Meletis note that a third child has vanished this month and no one knows what happened.
timeline.quote: "That makes three so far this month."

citation.text: "Dance of the Flitterstep" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Misty child spirits play through the agora at dawn and vanish into the walls, and Perisophia declares the children at rest.
timeline.quote: "The children are at rest.

citation.text: "Dance of the Flitterstep" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris refuses to hide, but Perisophia and the Twelve decide she must be moved to the garrison at Soli because enemy agents have infiltrated Meletis.
timeline.quote: We have conferred with the Temple and agreed that you will be moved to the garrison at Soli

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Alexio is presented as Iris's bodyguard; when she touches him she has a vision that he will fall in love with her and be taken from her, and resolves to prevent it.
timeline.quote: He was in love with her.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris and Alexio leave Meletis at dawn on the overland route south through the forest.
timeline.quote: Perisophia let go of Iris's hand as Alexio led her horse away

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Iris gallops carelessly away from Alexio, and he swoops down and saves her from an ambush by two men he believes are worshipers of Purphoros; her horse is lamed and put down.
timeline.quote: Judging by the markings on their weapons, I would guess they were worshipers of Purphoros.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Pursuers find the dead ambushers and the horse and track the Oracle and the Skyguard.
timeline.quote: Men, we will be home with our captive and the head of a Skyguard before the moon is full.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Alexio brings a friendly pegasus as a mount, and Iris and Alexio fly toward the mountains.
timeline.quote: Hold fast, but know that he will not let you fall.

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Euneas watches the Meletian plaza crushed beneath endless replacement columns until the city swallows him whole; he wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: The city had claimed him whole, another piece of sediment for the streets future inhabitants would trod upon in their brief doomed hours.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Transformed, Zosimos leaves the path to Meletis and follows a pull toward the eastern mountains, abandoning thoughts he calls the seeds of Phenax.
timeline.quote: Now he followed his destiny.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Diantha brings the Oracle of Kruphix her meal in Meletis and the oracle says Kruphix once spirited her away to his true temple.
timeline.quote: When I was in danger, Kruphix spirited me away to his temple.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Back in Meletis, the oracle tells Diantha she learned nothing to share, and gazes into the distance.
timeline.quote: There is nothing. Nothing at all.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora lands on Theros and calls a tsunami that devastates Meletis, and the Tritons take her for an avatar of Thassa.
timeline.quote: It struck the polis of Meletis and caused untold destruction

citation.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire with Kynaios and Tiro as guardians.
timeline.quote: The polis of Meletis was founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire as a beacon of freedom and enlightenment

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
timeline.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: A chariot accident blinds Tymna and ends her career among the Battlewise of Meletis.
timeline.quote: A career filled with victories was cut short by a chariot accident, leaving her blind.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Meletis blames Kedarick and declares support for the leonin mission to overthrow him; Akros and Setessa decline aid.
timeline.quote: Meletis formally declared its support for the Leonin mission to overthrow Kedarick

citation.text: "Kedarick VI", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zosimos finds peace and, instead of going to Meletis, turns toward distant eastern mountains.
timeline.quote: He had been heading to Meletis , but after the encounter with the satyr, something in him had shifted.

citation.text: "Zosimos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alexio is summoned by the Twelve and told to secretly escort Iris to the garrison at Soli.
timeline.quote: Head Speaker Perisophia told Alexio that he would escort Iris in secret to the garrison at Soli

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alexio and Iris ride out toward Soli; Alexio spots highwaymen in ambush.
timeline.quote: highwaymen who were waiting in ambush

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alexio rescues Iris from her horse and kills the two ambushers, whose weapons are Purphoran.
timeline.quote: The two men charged, but he killed them both in quick succession.

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alexio finds a loyal pegasus and they fly together.
timeline.quote: Alexio tracked down a loyal pegasus

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheltering from a storm in a cave, Alexio and Iris fall in love and spend the night together.
timeline.quote: The two spent the night entwined

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Attackers close in on the cave; Alexio is shot, sends Iris away on the pegasus, and stays to face the bandits.
timeline.quote: He faced off against several bandits inside the cave

citation.text: "Alexio", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elevated to demigod, Daxos is reformed by Heliod to destroy signs of other divinities in Meletis.
timeline.quote: He was reformed by Heliod with the task of destroying every sign of other divinities in Meletis

citation.text: "Daxos", section "Demigod". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Perisophia tells Iris she will be escorted in secret to Soli because Purphoros's agents plan to kidnap her.
timeline.quote: agents of Purphoros had been sent to kidnap her

citation.text: "Iris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Touching Alexio gives Iris a vision that he will love her and die.
timeline.quote: He would fall in love with her, and then he would be taken from her.

citation.text: "Iris", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod makes the oracle Daxos his champion and orders him to remove the other gods from Meletis; the gods go to war.
timeline.quote: he pulled the soul of the oracle Daxos and transformed him into his champion in the mortal realm

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Beyond Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls to Theros and is welcomed by Daxos's voice; she sees Meletis in ruins.
timeline.quote: "So you've not forgotten me, even with the new station,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees Ajani in Heliod's temple, converting gods and forcing a priestess to drink Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He's already changed three of them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Heroes of Theros shoot at Ajani, and he has a captured youth killed before the faithful.
timeline.quote: "Behold, one who turns away from the pack! One who plots against us!"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth weighs saving Theros against the larger war, and concludes the choice is not meant to be about her own wants.
timeline.quote: But this isn't meant to be about her own wants and needs.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Phyrexian forces compleat most of the gods; Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid and Kroxa obliterates invaders outside.
timeline.quote: Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Most gods are compleated while Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid, and Kroxa obliterates invaders in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The city of Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ephara visits Perisophia in dreams and warns of Xenagos.
timeline.quote: the god warned her champion of the coming of Xenagos

citation.text: "Perisophia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani spreads word in Meletis of Heliod's misdeeds, then returns to Tethmos to share information with the Leonin.
timeline.quote: he returned to Tethmos and announced that he would share information

citation.text: "Seza", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Solon returns to Meletis hailed as a great warrior.
timeline.quote: He later returned to Meletis and was hailed as a great warrior

citation.text: "Solon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mortals endure and thrive on Theros behind the walls of great poleis, each a bulwark against raging monsters.
timeline.quote: each city-state a bulwark against the raging monsters that roam the more savage places of Theros.

citation.text: "Theros". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: Klytessa came to Iretis from Meletis.
relations.quote: I remember that day you first arrived from Meletis.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Nov 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: She is the god of city-states and is particularly worshipped in Meletis.
relations.quote: in particular she is worshipped in Meletis.

citation.work: The Gods of Born of the Gods
citation.text: "The Gods of Born of the Gods" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2014.

relations.quote: A council of philosophers called the Twelve now serves as the ruling body of Meletis.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Government". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Meletis", section "Locations in the polis of Meletis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: philosopher council that governs the polis
relations.quote: Meletis is governed by the philosopher council known as the Twelve

citation.text: "Mortal Realm", section "Life in the Poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: City on Theros from which the king's wife and child were traveling to Iretis.

citation.text: "Building Toward a Dream, Part 2". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Dec 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Born of the Gods". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

pages_say.description: The polis where Ephara is particularly worshipped.

citation.work: The Gods of Born of the Gods
citation.text: "The Gods of Born of the Gods" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2014.

pages_say.description: Pavios's home polis, where he is to be married.

citation.text: "Emonberry Red" by Clayton Kroh. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Feb 2014.

pages_say.description: A scholarly city of Theros whose walls have ears.

citation.work: Born of the Gods: card flavor text
citation.text: Born of the Gods: card flavor text (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A human polis near where Kiora arrives.

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.
